description: This is a test suite for JPEG transcoding functions, including creating solid color and noisy JPEG images, and testing various transcoding scenarios such as resizing, orientation normalization, and byte size limits.

methods.name: makeSolidJPEG
methods.description: Creates a solid color JPEG image data with specified width, height, and optional orientation.

methods.name: makeNoiseJPEG
methods.description: Creates a noisy (random pixel data) JPEG image of specified width and height.

methods.name: downscalesToMaxWidthPx
methods.description: Test that JPEG transcoding correctly downsizes images to a maximum pixel width.

methods.name: doesNotUpscaleWhenSmallerThanMaxWidthPx
methods.description: Test that images smaller than the maximum width are not upscaled during transcoding.

methods.name: normalizesOrientationAndUsesOrientedWidthForMaxWidthPx
methods.description: Test that image orientation is normalized and width calculations account for orientation during resizing.

methods.name: respectsMaxBytes
methods.description: Test that JPEG transcoding respects a maximum byte size limit.
